map.一线城市 5 天差旅补贴: 5-day travel subsidy in a first-tier city
map.：出差地：一线城市，天数 5 天，伙食补助标准 100 元/天，市内交通补助 8: : destination: first-tier city, 5 days, meal allowance 100 CNY/day, local transport allowance 80 CNY/day. Total subsidy = (100+80) × 5 = 900 CNY. If meals are provided by the host for 2 of those days, the meal allowance counts 3 days = 300 CNY, totaling 540 CNY, reflecting the principle of 'actual reimbursement, no double claiming'.

This tool only does the arithmetic, so enter the standards you actually apply.
map.已经由接待方安排食宿还能领补助吗？: If the host already arranged room and board, can you still claim the subsidy?
map.一般规定：由接待单位负担伙食的，不再发放伙食补助；交通同理。工具支持按实际天数分: Generally, when the host covers meals the meal allowance is not paid; the same applies to transport. The tool supports issuing by actual days, so deduct truthfully when filling in to avoid over-claiming.
